_comment: EPHEMERAL — I2P eepsite availability changes without notice. These 5 targets are historically reachable destinations used for smoke-testing the probe/extractor pipeline. Refresh periodically (monthly recommended). Do NOT hardcode into application source; this is a test configuration file only.

targets.name: I2P-Projekt
targets.description: Official I2P project site hosted inside the network. Long-standing reference eepsite with news, downloads, and documentation.
targets.notes: One of the most stable I2P destinations; used in official tutorials.

targets.name: I2P-Stat
targets.description: I2P network statistics portal showing live router count, tunnel bandwidth, and network health metrics.
targets.notes: Also referenced in existing probe_sites.py test data. Renders tabular HTML with network stats.

targets.name: SuicideForum BBS
targets.description: One of the oldest I2P forums. PHPBB-based discussion platform with very long operational history, serving as a reference eepsite for base32 address formats.
targets.notes: Uses base32 address directly rather than .i2p DNS. High uptime historically due to long operation history.

targets.name: Herald I2P News
targets.description: I2P-hosted news/blog site. Community-run content aggregator inside the network with regular post updates.
targets.notes: Standard .i2p hostname resolution via internal SD (Site Database). May return varying status codes depending on maintenance.

targets.name: Debianize I2P
targets.description: Package repository mirror for I2P router/deb packages on Debian/Ubuntu systems. Subsite of i2p-projekt infrastructure.
targets.notes: Shares hosting infrastructure with I2P-Projekt so availability correlates. Serves HTML package index pages.
